key_insight: MANTA lets a multi-agent system adapt its communication topology during inference, so collaboration can self-evolve when the current structure is no longer sufficient.
engineering_relevance: This suggests a practical way to improve LLM agent systems without changing the task interface or agent budget, by dynamically updating roles, links, ordering, visibility, and validation.
method: Initialize a task-conditioned topology from prior structural experience before execution.
Monitor collaboration traces during deployment and trigger bounded structural updates when needed.
Adapt communication structure while preserving the same agents and overall task interface.
evidence_signal: Across five benchmarks in information seeking, tool use, planning, workflow execution, and mathematical reasoning, MANTA achieved the highest average score of 74.0 and beat the strongest baseline by 5.8 points, with the best result on PlanCraft.
watch_item: Dynamic topology updates add runtime complexity and may be sensitive to when and how structural changes are triggered.
paper_title: MANTA: Multi-Agent Network Topology Adaptation for Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems
